item.title: Mashburn Construction marks 50 years, plans move to Seaboard Vista
item.description: Mashburn Construction celebrates its 50th anniversary with plans to relocate its corporate headquarters to Seaboard Vista in Columbia by late 2026. The post Mashburn Construction marks 50 years, plans move to Seaboard Vista appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Mother, son developer break ground on Seabrook Island townhomes
item.description: Developers broke ground on 11 luxury townhomes at The Inlet at Seabrook Island featuring marsh views, private elevators and completion expected this fall. The post Mother, son developer break ground on Seabrook Island townhomes appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Hydrite Chemical to invest $63M in Laurens County expansion
